introHtml: Plastic bag clips offer a lightweight, durable, and cost-effective way to keep bags sealed tight. Unlike metal clips, they won't rust or scratch surfaces, making them ideal for kitchen or pantry use. Customize them with your logo using pad printing or debossing for a subtle brand presence. Perfect for grocery chains, meal kit services, or corporate gift sets.
